known.via: English Wikipedia "Altiplano de Sierra Nevada" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra covering municipalities in the north of Granada province, formerly called Norte de Granada. It sits one step below the DO level and gained its status in 2005.
